pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: Introduce the Crane RoboCup SSL system, summarizing its purpose as a complete robot soccer control stack including perception, planning, skills, and communication

pages.title: System Architecture
pages.purpose: Describe the high-level architecture showing how the major subsystems (perception, world model, planning, skills, communication) interact

pages.title: ROS 2 Package Structure
pages.purpose: Detail the ROS 2 package organization, dependencies, and how packages are structured within the crane ecosystem

pages.title: Data Flow Pipeline
pages.purpose: Explain the complete data flow from sensor inputs (vision, tracker, referee) through world model to robot commands

pages.title: World Model System
pages.purpose: Describe the central world model that provides unified game state to all decision-making components

pages.title: World Model Wrapper
pages.purpose: Document the WorldModelWrapper API, including ball tracking, robot queries, slack time calculations, and geometric utilities

pages.title: World Model Publisher
pages.purpose: Explain WorldModelPublisher and WorldModelDataProvider components that fuse sensor data and publish the unified world state

pages.title: Ball Owner Calculator
pages.purpose: Detail the BallOwnerCalculator subsystem that determines which robot can reach the ball first

pages.title: Strategic Planning
pages.purpose: Describe high-level strategic decision making including play situation interpretation and role assignment

pages.title: Play Switcher
pages.purpose: Document the play switcher component that interprets referee commands and vision data to determine game state

pages.title: Planner Plugin Architecture
pages.purpose: Explain the planner plugin system for role assignment and formation control

pages.title: Robot Skills Framework
pages.purpose: Document the modular skill system that encapsulates robot behaviors as composable, reusable components

pages.title: Skill Base Classes
pages.purpose: Detail SkillInterface, SkillBase, and SkillBaseWithState abstract classes that provide the skill framework

pages.title: State Machine Architecture
pages.purpose: Explain the StateMachine class used by stateful skills for managing transitions and complex behaviors

pages.title: Goalie Skill
pages.purpose: Document the goalkeeper skill including shot blocking, ball emission, and defensive positioning strategies

pages.title: Attacker Skills
pages.purpose: Detail offensive skills including Attacker, SubAttacker, and their state machines for shooting and passing

pages.title: Ball Handling Skills
pages.purpose: Document ball manipulation skills including SingleBallPlacement, Kick, Receive, and MoveWithBall

pages.title: Support Skills
pages.purpose: Cover utility skills like Idle, Sleep, Marker, Teleop, and BallNearbyPositioner

pages.title: Local Motion Planning
pages.purpose: Describe the local planner that converts high-level commands into collision-free robot trajectories

pages.title: Local Planner Framework
pages.purpose: Document LocalPlannerComponent, coordinate transformations, and the planner interface

pages.title: RVO2 Collision Avoidance
pages.purpose: Explain the RVO2Planner including target override, ORCA constraints, and multi-agent planning

pages.title: Trajectory Generation
pages.purpose: Detail BangBangTrajectory classes for optimal time trajectories and velocity planning

pages.title: Robot Communication
pages.purpose: Document the complete communication pipeline for robot command transmission and feedback reception

pages.title: Message Interfaces
pages.purpose: Detail crane_msgs message definitions including RobotCommand, WorldModel, and RobotFeedback

pages.title: Robot Command System
pages.purpose: Explain RobotCommandWrapper API for constructing commands with position, velocity, kick, and dribble parameters

pages.title: Sender System
pages.purpose: Document SenderBase, SimSender, and IbisSender for transmitting commands to simulated and real robots

pages.title: Robot Feedback Reception
pages.purpose: Explain RobotReceiverNode, feedback protocol parsing, and sensor data integration

pages.title: Communication Utilities
pages.purpose: Document crane_comm package utilities for UDP communication and network management

pages.title: Visualization & Debugging
pages.purpose: Describe tools and systems for visualizing robot behavior and debugging the system

pages.title: Visualization System
pages.purpose: Document crane_visualization_interfaces and CraneVisualizerBuffer for debug rendering
